hypothesis: BTC can exhibit continuation after breaking a fully observed range at fixed eight-hour UTC liquidity blocks, with different behavior on weekdays and weekends.
research_proxy: BTCUSDT Binance spot official monthly klines
derivation_disclosure: Independent session mechanism requested before any v13 performance was inspected. V11/v12 parameters and performance are not reused.

data_contract.input: checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H1
data_contract.session_anchor: fixed UTC blocks starting 00:00, 08:00 or 16:00; no retrospective best-hour search
data_contract.day_group: weekday or weekend determined by session anchor date
data_contract.proxy_limitation: Research only until BTCUSDT/BTCUSD Ostium parity passes

execution_contract.range: first 2 or 4 complete H1 bars from session anchor
execution_contract.trigger: first completed H1 close outside the frozen range during the registered window
execution_contract.exit: ATR catastrophe stop or close after 2/4/8 H1 bars
execution_contract.position_policy: one position per candidate; at most one signal per anchored session; overlapping signals ignored

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component per categorical group without performance metrics

sqcli_policy: No SQCLI until stable development, validation, OOS and small-account gates pass.
